title: DECISION: Separate test routers reflect real network architecture
description: peer_attachment_fetch.rs uses 4 separate router instances: sender_tcp (real TLS listener for fetch), sender_owner_router (upload), receiver_owner_router (owner download), receiver_peer_router (Peer/deliver). Not test bloat — reflects real architecture where daemons are separate processes. Each router has independent WhoIs identity. Test structure mirrors deployment topology.
